# BracketView

> BracketView is a freemium online JSON viewer, formatter, validator, and query workspace for developers. Built by Jameel Shaikh. Available at https://bracketview.in

## What it does
BracketView lets developers format, validate, query, and share JSON in the browser — no install required. Core tools run 100% client-side (data never leaves the browser).

## Key features
- JSON Tree View and Graph View for nested data exploration
- One-click JSON formatter (beautify) and minifier
- Real-time JSON validator with inline error highlighting
- JSONPath query support ($.store.book[*].author syntax)
- JQ Filter Playground powered by WebAssembly — full jq in the browser
- AI JSON Fixer: automatically repairs broken JSON (missing commas, unquoted keys, etc.)
- AI Mock Data Generator: creates test data from JSON Schema
- AI Query Assistant: converts plain English to jq expressions
- JSON Diff: side-by-side comparison of two JSON versions
- JSON Schema Validator and Generator
- Type Generator: exports TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and 9+ other language types from JSON
- Encrypted shareable snapshot links with optional expiry
- WebRTC Nearby Share: transfer JSON between browsers using a 6-character code or QR scan
- Annotations: attach notes to JSON keys and values
- Encoder/Decoder utility
- JSON Stats View: node count, depth, structure analysis

## Pricing
- Free: full workspace, monthly AI limits, uploads up to 10 MB, 50 lifetime snapshot links
- Pro Monthly: $6/month — unlimited AI, 50 MB uploads, unlimited snapshots
- Pro Yearly: $54/year ($4.50/month) — same Pro features, 25% savings

## Use cases
API debugging, webhook payload review, config management, log cleanup, API version diffing, schema documentation

## Technical details
- 100% client-side for core tools (privacy-first)
- Works in any modern browser, no install
- Payments via Razorpay
- Featured on Product Hunt and SaaSHub
